items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Lorenzo' only in response to the interviewer's prompt ('There's papa and Lorenzo. Lorenzo's daddy.') and does not provide any personal anecdote, interaction, or description of a relationship with Lorenzo.

ctx.x: His dad. He used to live here, you see. Born and raised here, Teo did.
There's papa and Lorenzo. Lorenzo's daddy. I think he was Lorenzo Junior. Yeah, I think so, but then they had another brother, papa. Yeah, another brother.
